acceptanceCriteria: Real production Core late-compiler cancellation reproducer returns cancellation and cannot emit READY after the request context is cancelled.
Cold, early and late cancellation retire joined work and a healthy subsequent request succeeds; retain measured bounds and any unproven worst-case limit explicitly.
Uncancelled context receipts and abstentions retain their existing evidence bindings, and fixture disk/repository/trace state remains unchanged.
Independent review and applicable focused tests plus governing final checks pass; retain failed evaluations and rollback.
body:
Observed while implementing LSP context requests. At immutable merged base624e9aecbf71993d26c57b2e20837282469cb02c, real NewTaskReview/Registry.Call(ToolContext) cancellation triggered inside taskContextCompiler.lexicalRows returns READY with nil error after about2ms. Reproduced twice using runtime-stack sampling; final fail-closed assertion intentionally fails. Cold/early loader cancellation joined within7ms and healthy subsequent requests succeeded. This is a late cancellation correctness gap, not an observed hang or a proven20second bound violation. Reproduction and immutable-source receipts: /tmp/lsp-editor-core-cancellation-proof.md and /tmp/lsp-core-cancel-proof/run.py (expected failure), test.log, late-test-first.log, source-binding.json.

Relevant implementation: taskcontext.go synchronous compile then packet/span/snapshot paths lack final cancellation check; lexicalRows/lexicalHits lack checks; bridge.Call checks context at entry but not final success. A final guard can suppress READY but does not prove worst-case retirement; assess required stage/loop cancellation separately. Preserve ABSTAINED/normal-success behavior on uncancelled calls and default read-only behavior.

LSP V1-0481 is separately building a bounded owned-worker/publication guard to avoid exposing this gap; that adapter workaround does not resolve this underlying Core API ticket. No Core cancellation refactor or completed fix is claimed. Scope/effects remain INCOMPLETE until audit.

completion.reason: Delivered in batch K2 (beamfall/corvint#695, merge a4acc6f6); focused tests, doc gates, dogfood bind/check/seal and independent review passed; evidence is the sha256 of the lane and batch build-logs at the merge commit.

title: Core context cancellation can return READY after late compilation cancellation
